Synchronizing your MosaicSync layout…

Waiting for your Firefox account to deliver the MosaicSync layout. This can take a few minutes; your shortcuts will appear automatically when it arrives.

MosaicSync uses Firefox's own Sync service instead of a MosaicSync server. That keeps sync inside your Mozilla account and lets MosaicSync stay serverless: no MosaicSync account, analytics, or telemetry. Firefox decides when extension data moves between computers.

Backup & transfer

Save your complete MosaicSync setup or move it to another browser or computer.

Export MosaicSync profileSave a complete local backup with both Spaces, folders, settings, custom artwork, learned favicons and wallpapers. The file is independent of browser Sync limits.
Import MosaicSync profileRestore a .mosaicsync backup. The format is browser-neutral so it can move your setup between MosaicSync browser editions.
